policy: Armenia aggregate outputs may be released only with attribution and disclosure review. ArmStat's public anonymised download does not establish permission to redistribute raw ILCS rows, derived unit records, or row-aligned weights; those artifacts remain local until an exact written permission record is reviewed and pinned.

licence.name: ArmStat ILCS public anonymised download; redistribution grant not established
licence.notes: The official ILCS page supports public anonymised download and internal analysis. No express permission was found for redistribution of raw rows, transformed unit records, or row-aligned calibration weights. Written ArmStat permission is required before any such publication.

notes: The target dataset year is 2024. source_coverage.json follows the country-neutral populace#265 contract. validation_bands.json reports ArmStat national-accounts comparisons plus harvested CEQ/World Bank oracle bands; the latter are never gates unless promoted through Ledger. Unit-record and row-aligned artifacts are not publication-eligible. Remote Armenian staging is disabled until aggregate-only telemetry schemas are reviewed; the named private staging repository is reserved for that future reviewed surface. Written permission would require a separate reviewed contract change, fresh build, and separate human publication decision.
